slides.headline: AI may have already learned from your public posts
Mathematicians ask OpenAI for proof
slides.body: Top math group formally requested evidence their published papers weren't used to train ChatGPT

slides.headline: Same risk for every creator
slides.body: If you've posted writing, art, code, or research online, it could be in AI training data right now

slides.headline: No way to check or opt out
slides.body: OpenAI and others don't reveal training sources; no tool exists to see if your work was used

slides.headline: Lawsuits coming but protection missing
slides.body: Publishers and artists are suing, but everyday creators have zero legal shield or compensation path today

slides.headline: Follow for AI rights updates
slides.body: We track what AI companies take from you — and what you can do about it
